ABOUT GOALS GLASGOW SOUTH

GOALS Glasgow South offers the best small-sided football facilities in the city. Simple.

Our home form is truly outstanding from our individually floodlit arenas complete with cutting-edge, all-weather surfaces to our additional top-class facilities, competitive leagues, and exciting local tournaments.

You can keep up-to-date with us on social media.

GETTING HERE

GOALS Glasgow South is located beside Queens Park along Pollokshaws Road, across from the pub Sweeney's. If you are coming from the city centre, carry on straight along Pollokshaws Road and take the first left into the park after the Marks and Spencer's Garage.

BRAND-NEW PITCHES
A PERFECT MATCH?

6 of our 5-a-side pitches have been freshly re-laid with brand-new ProTurf, have you tried it out yet?

Our doors are open to the community in the Southside of Glasgow offering football pitch hire for all on 5-a-side arenas, leagues, kid's parties, corporate events, tournaments, functions, and hall hire.

We've been putting in the graft behind the scenes at GOALS Glasgow South – and now it's your turn to reap the rewards.

If you've played with us before and felt the surface wasn't up to scratch – we heard you. And, we've gone big to put it right. We've invested £100,000 into the club, starting with a massive pitch upgrade and we've even replaced the pitch kickboards and goal nets.

6 out of 9 of our 5-a-side pitches have been ripped up and replaced with brand-new ProTurf surfaces. So, whether you're playing for points or just for pride, the surface is looking slick, and ready to roll. 

Pop in, or head over to our Facebook and Instagram to check out the transformation for yourself. 

If you've not been down in a while, now's the perfect time to get the boots back on and feel the difference.

Be one of the first to play on the new surface.

LEAGUES AHEAD

Is your team looking for competitive, weekly games?

Our professional-run 5-a-side football leagues have dedicated league managers, committed teams of all abilities, GOALS referees, and great winner's prizes up for grabs, including cash and experiences from our local sponsors!

Join our:

Sunday League
Trade Waste Tuesday League
Cafe India Thornliebank Thursday League
PIATTO Saturday Inclusive League

So… How does it work? Simply get your team together and play a trial game at a reduced cost; this is where you get a taste of the GOALS League experience. We then evaluate your team's ability before allocating you to an appropriate, competitive division.

Are you game? Tap below to kick off.

TRIAL MATCH
PLAY, SAVE, REPEAT.

Football is a great way to have fun and get fit and with our artificial surface, ProTurf®, you'll be playing as close to grass as you can be. It's designed specifically for small-sided football, and completely exclusive to GOALS delivering natural gameplay, pace, and is easier on your joints allowing you to play for longer. Choose a casual pitch booking for game time with no commitment, playing when you like, as often as you like.

Dedicated baller? We've got you covered at GOALS Glasgow South with a block booking. Secure the same pitch at the same time every week with zero upfront cost, simply pay as normal every week. You'll also be eligible for loyalty vouchers that can be used to pay for those post-match pints in our players' lounge.

Play football, get fit, feel good. Take your game to the next level by tapping below.

BLOCK BOOK
PLANNING A PARTY?

A dedicated in-house events team is on hand to help with catering from local Italian PIATTO, decorations, and music options, leaving you free to relax and enjoy your occasion.

Our modern function suite is available on selected weekdays, Fridays, Saturdays, and Sundays. With a hall capacity of 120 people, including kids, you won't have to compromise on your guest list.

Party until midnight at your hassle-free function for as little as a refundable £100 deposit. Then, show off your best dance moves on our neighbour's dance floor; free entry into TheShed nightclub for all Friday evening partygoers. 

Our local partnerships ensure you get the best quality event whilst supporting small Shawlands-based businesses. Hall hire, event hire, weddings, engagement parties, retirement parties, or milestone birthdays, whatever your event, we can look after you. 

Get in touch below and let us take care of the rest.

ENQUIRE
KICKABOUT

Maybe you're not a planner, after a casual Kickabout with a few friends or, you're a parent trying to keep your children active; our Kickabout sessions are a flexible way to level up.

Pitches are available from early morning to late-night sessions on fully enclosed arenas from only £5 per child and £6 per adult on 5-a-side.

Stay fit with your friends
Play when it suits you
1 hour pitch time guaranteed
No booking required
No commitment

Simply get your mates together, hit the pitch, and play football.

*Pitch exclusivity isn't guaranteed, this is subject to pitch availability.

KIDS FOOTBALL PARTIES IN GLASGOW

Enjoy an unforgettable kids party at GOALS whatever the weather, on our outdoor all-weather ProTurf pitches. Whether you choose our Premier Party or prefer to Build Your Own, your little football star is guaranteed a day to remember.

Parties are priced based on a minimum of 10 children, with the option to add more guests for an additional cost – either when booking or closer to the big day.

Every party takes place in a fun, safe and fully supervised environment, giving you peace of mind while the kids enjoy non-stop football action.

And that's just the start – from Panini goodies and party bags to trophies, medals, and tasty upgrades like pizza, ice cream and slushies, there are loads of ways to make their big day even more unforgettable.
